parameters.query:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (s:Saison {id: row.id})
ON CREATE SET s.annee = row.annee, s.created_at = datetime()
ON MATCH  SET s.updated_at = datetime()
RETURN count(s) AS nb

additionalFields.parameters: ={{ JSON.stringify({ rows: $('Fusionner données validées').first().json.games_rows ? [...new Set($('Fusionner données validées').all().flatMap(i => i.json.rows || []).map(r => r.SEASON).filter(Boolean))].map(s => ({id: String(s), annee: parseInt(s)})) : [] }) }}

parameters.query:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (e:Equipe {id: row.id})
ON CREATE SET
  e.team_id      = row.team_id,
  e.nom          = row.nom,
  e.ville        = row.ville,
  e.abbreviation = row.abbreviation,
  e.conference   = row.conference,
  e.created_at   = datetime()
ON MATCH SET
  e.nom          = COALESCE(row.nom, e.nom),
  e.ville        = COALESCE(row.ville, e.ville),
  e.conference   = COALESCE(row.conference, e.conference),
  e.updated_at   = datetime()
RETURN count(e) AS nb

UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (j:Joueur {id: row.id})
ON CREATE SET
  j.player_id  = row.player_id,
  j.nom        = row.nom,
  j.nickname   = row.nickname,
  j.created_at = datetime()
ON MATCH SET
  j.nom        = COALESCE(row.nom, j.nom),
  j.nickname   = COALESCE(row.nickname, j.nickname),
  j.updated_at = datetime()
RETURN count(j) AS nb

UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (m:Match {id: row.id})
ON CREATE SET
  m.game_id      = row.game_id,
  m.date_est     = row.date_est,
  m.statut       = row.statut,
  m.saison_id    = row.saison_id,
  m.score_home   = row.score_home,
  m.score_away   = row.score_away,
  m.home_team_id = row.home_team_id,
  m.away_team_id = row.away_team_id,
  m.created_at   = datetime()
ON MATCH SET
  m.statut     = row.statut,
  m.score_home = COALESCE(row.score_home, m.score_home),
  m.score_away = COALESCE(row.score_away, m.score_away),
  m.updated_at = datetime()
RETURN count(m) AS nb

UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (p:Performance {id: row.id})
ON CREATE SET
  p.joueur_id    = row.joueur_id,
  p.match_id     = row.match_id,
  p.equipe_id    = row.equipe_id,
  p.position     = row.position,
  p.min_secondes = row.min_secondes,
  p.fgm = row.fgm, p.fga = row.fga,
  p.fg3m= row.fg3m,p.fg3a= row.fg3a,
  p.ftm = row.ftm, p.fta = row.fta,
  p.oreb= row.oreb,p.dreb= row.dreb,
  p.reb = row.reb, p.ast = row.ast,
  p.stl = row.stl, p.blk = row.blk,
  p.tov = row.tov, p.pf  = row.pf,
  p.pts = row.pts, p.plus_minus = row.plus_minus,
  p.created_at   = datetime()
ON MATCH SET p.updated_at = datetime()
RETURN count(p) AS nb

UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (c:Classement {id: row.id})
ON CREATE SET
  c.team_id      = row.team_id,
  c.date         = row.date,
  c.season_id    = row.season_id,
  c.conference   = row.conference,
  c.nom_equipe   = row.nom_equipe,
  c.matchs_joues = row.matchs_joues,
  c.victoires    = row.victoires,
  c.defaites     = row.defaites,
  c.w_pct        = row.w_pct,
  c.home_record  = row.home_record,
  c.road_record  = row.road_record,
  c.created_at   = datetime()
ON MATCH SET c.updated_at = datetime()
RETURN count(c) AS nb

// JOUE_POUR (temporelle par saison)
UNWIND $joue_pour AS row
MATCH (j:Joueur {id: row.joueur_id})
MATCH (e:Equipe {id: row.equipe_id})
MERGE (j)-[r:JOUE_POUR {saison: row.saison}]->(e)
ON CREATE SET r.actif = row.actif, r.created_at = datetime()
ON MATCH  SET r.actif = row.actif;

// REALISE + LORS_DE + POUR_EQUIPE
UNWIND $performances AS row
MATCH (j:Joueur      {id: row.joueur_id})
MATCH (p:Performance {id: row.perf_id})
MATCH (m:Match       {id: row.match_id})
MATCH (e:Equipe      {id: row.equipe_id})
MERGE (j)-[:REALISE]->(p)
MERGE (p)-[:LORS_DE]->(m)
MERGE (p)-[:POUR_EQUIPE]->(e);

// A_CLASSEMENT
UNWIND $classements AS row
MATCH (e:Equipe     {id: row.equipe_id})
MATCH (c:Classement {id: row.classement_id})
MERGE (e)-[:A_CLASSEMENT]->(c);

RETURN 'relations_joueurs_ok' AS statut

// Invariant 1 : nœuds isolés
MATCH (p:Performance) WHERE NOT (p)--() WITH count(p) AS perfs_isolees
MATCH (m:Match)       WHERE NOT (m)--() WITH perfs_isolees, count(m) AS matchs_isoles

// Invariant 2 : FGM ≤ FGA
MATCH (perf:Performance) WHERE perf.fgm IS NOT NULL AND perf.fga IS NOT NULL AND perf.fgm > perf.fga
WITH perfs_isolees, matchs_isoles, count(perf) AS fg_invalides

// Invariant 3 : W+L=G
MATCH (c:Classement) WHERE c.victoires IS NOT NULL AND c.defaites IS NOT NULL AND c.matchs_joues IS NOT NULL AND (c.victoires + c.defaites) <> c.matchs_joues
WITH perfs_isolees, matchs_isoles, fg_invalides, count(c) AS classements_invalides

// Comptes globaux
MATCH (j:Joueur)   WITH perfs_isolees, matchs_isoles, fg_invalides, classements_invalides, count(j) AS nb_joueurs
MATCH (e:Equipe)   WITH perfs_isolees, matchs_isoles, fg_invalides, classements_invalides, nb_joueurs, count(e) AS nb_equipes
MATCH (m2:Match)   WITH perfs_isolees, matchs_isoles, fg_invalides, classements_invalides, nb_joueurs, nb_equipes, count(m2) AS nb_matchs
MATCH (p2:Performance) WITH perfs_isolees, matchs_isoles, fg_invalides, classements_invalides, nb_joueurs, nb_equipes, nb_matchs, count(p2) AS nb_perfs

RETURN
  perfs_isolees, matchs_isoles, fg_invalides, classements_invalides,
  nb_joueurs, nb_equipes, nb_matchs, nb_perfs,
  CASE WHEN perfs_isolees = 0 AND matchs_isoles = 0 AND fg_invalides = 0 AND classements_invalides = 0
       THEN 'SAIN' ELSE 'DÉGRADÉ' END AS statut_graphe
